purpose: Describe size-independent body structure in a species-agnostic form that shared systems can query without species-name branching.
source_basis: DevelopmentBible/02-game-framework/creatures-npcs-and-species.md Species: physical traits and compatibility constraints
DevelopmentBible/02-game-framework/characters-and-progression.md Character composition: species/form selections and inventory remain separate aggregate concerns
MVPS-03 approved objective and acceptance criteria

does_not_own: equipment compatibility policy or fit formulas

body_plan_family_policy.rule: Family labels aid authoring/search but never select mechanics or code paths.

body_region_contract.rule: Regions describe topology/surfaces only; dimensions and mechanical scale remain external.

limb_contract.rule: A limb is a structural branch; locomotion and action capability are separate shared grants/rules.

manipulator_contract.rule: Manipulator tags expose physical structure for later capability/equipment queries without embedding action or proficiency rules.

worn_region_contract.rule: A worn region exposes a structural surface only. Layering, sizing, armor math and compatibility decisions remain equipment-owner policy.

attachment_point_contract.rule: Attachment points indicate structural places an external system may evaluate; they do not grant an item or implant.

natural_appendage_contract.rule: Claws, horns, tails, tendrils, shells and similar anatomy are represented structurally here; executable natural equipment/capabilities belong to MVPS-06/shared owner records.
